releases.body:
- Filter retained transcripts to conversation text by default, omitting tool outputs, reasoning parts, thinking-style tags, synthetic text, and ignored text.
- Add retainConversationExtras, defaulting to false, so the older verbose retain behavior can be explicitly enabled when needed.

- Fix package metadata and TUI command registration so .opencode/tui.json can load /hindsight-retain from the package.
- Make TUI manual retain reuse the server plugin options from opencode.json and hydrate TUI message parts before formatting the retained transcript.
- Document the required split between server plugin configuration in opencode.json and TUI plugin activation in tui.json.

- Simplify Hindsight configuration to a one-agent/one-bank responsibility model for automatic recall, automatic retention, manual tools, and TUI retain.
- Replace the previous multi-bank configuration surface with focused agent defaults, opt-in/opt-out behavior, and per-agent overrides.
- Update implementation, tests, and README guidance for the breaking pre-1.0 configuration change.

- Add a manual TUI session-retain command for retaining session transcripts on demand.
- Share retain behavior across automatic and manual flows with expanded configuration and content handling.
- Document manual TUI session retain usage and add focused TUI coverage.

- Add session-start context controls for automatic recall, including mental model and custom recall prompt support.
- Expand recall handling so session-start context can be configured, persisted, and tested across plugin state and client boundaries.
- Document the session-start mental model and custom recall prompt behavior.
